question: Which form of leucoplast specialises in oil synthesis and storage and is mainly found in the layer of cells in pollen grains that develop pollen grains?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Elaioplasts.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elaioplasts** are a type of** leucoplasts **that specialize in **oil synthesis and storage.**
 
• They are mainly found in the** layer of cells** in **pollen grains** that develop pollen grains.
 
• Elaioplasts are also found in the** seeds of plants** and are responsible for** storing oils and fats.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gerontoplasts **are the type of plastids that are formed from** chloroplasts **during the process of senescence (aging) of the plant cell.
 
• **Proteinoplasts **are the type of plastids that are involved in the **synthesis and storage of proteins.**
 
• **Chloroplasts **are the type of plastids that are responsible for** photosynthesis** in plant cells.
